primary_sources: Pazos M, Traverso CE, Viswanathan A; European Glaucoma Society. Terminology and guidelines for glaucoma, 6th edition. Br J Ophthalmol 2025;109(Suppl 1):1-212
OFTY Module Architecture Standard (MAS) — Section 3.4 (Three-layer integration)

rules.name: Layer 1 — Structural-functional pattern recognition
rules.specification: Classifies the relationship between M3 and M4 outputs into one of six pattern types

patterns.concordant_stable: Both M3 and M4 stable (no progression in either domain)
patterns.concordant_progression: Both M3 and M4 show progression (any rate combination)
patterns.partial_assessment: One domain unclassifiable, other domain classified
patterns.insufficient_data: Both domains unclassifiable, or critical inputs missing

rules.implementation_note: Layer 1 operates on the discrete classification states produced by M3 (5 states) and M4 (7 states). Discordance is flagged but not algorithmically resolved — clinical judgement is preserved as primary.

rules.name: Layer 2 — IOP status overlay
rules.specification: Contextualizes the Layer 1 pattern by IOP status relative to target, computed from M1 and M2 outputs

iop_states.unknown: Either current_iop_mmhg or target range is missing

integration_logic: Pattern + IOP state combine into integrated_classification (e.g., 'stable_controlled', 'progression_with_iop_above_target', 'floor_effect_context')
21 distinct outcome family branches mapped from the Cartesian product of pattern and IOP state
Risk tier assigned based on combined pattern and IOP context (low/moderate/high/indeterminate)
rules.implementation_note: Layer 2 enforces clinical invariants: e.g., concordant_progression with above_target must produce high-risk tier; floor_effect with progression must retain functional-driven framing.

rules.name: Layer 3 — Confidence adjustment
rules.specification: Derives integrated confidence from minimum of upstream module confidences plus penalty rules for specific contexts
logic: Base confidence = min(M1.confidence, M2.confidence, M3.confidence, M4.confidence)
Penalty -1 tier if structural-functional discordance detected
Penalty -1 tier if floor effect or signal-limited modifiers active
Penalty -1 tier if any caution flag from upstream modules suggests reduced reliability
rules.implementation_note: Confidence reflects the completeness and quality of the data stream. Stage override or current IOP edit by clinician do not trigger penalty (clinician input is treated as ground truth for engine execution).

rules.name: Provenance and audit trail
rules.specification: Records the source of every input used by the orchestrator in the logic_trace, enabling full auditability
rules.implementation_note: Provenance is added in v1.0.1 as additive output schema enrichment (per MAS S1.3 patch-level rules). Existing v1.0.0 fields are preserved unchanged. JSON consumers that ignore unknown keys continue to function without modification.

verification_summary.combinatorial_axes: M3 (6 states) × M4 (8 states) × IOP-vs-target (4 states)
